stage0018_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Federation Soldier
「Damn monster!
　It broke through the first defense line!」

stage0018_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
Federation Soldier
「I heard the N2 mine damaged it, but
　it's already regenerated that much...!」

stage0018_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Federation Soldier
「All units, spread out!
　We hold it here, no matter what!」

stage0018_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$大塚$$
「It's all right, Vice Commander $$冬月$$!
　The unit I arranged should arrive any moment!」

stage0018_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...that one still hasn't arrived?」

stage0018_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$冬月$$
「Lt. Col. Katsuragi should be meeting them.」

stage0018_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$大塚$$
「Commander Ikari!
　Is that Angel headed here, beneath
　$$第３新東京市$$... is that its target!?」

stage0018_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That's correct.
　And once the Angel reaches NERV Headquarters...」

stage0018_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$葵$$
「I don't really get it, but
　looks like the Federation deployed to intercept it.」

stage0018_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Creeps me out...
　Even after fighting $$次元獣$$s and Invaders,
　I still go 'ugh...' about it.」

stage0018_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$大塚$$
「Can you hear me, all of you!
　It's me, $$大塚$$!」

stage0018_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Director $$大塚$$!
　So you're in this city too, sir!」

stage0018_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「But I don't see any facility that looks like it...」

stage0018_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$大塚$$
「Talk later!
　That monster you're looking at is called an Angel!」

stage0018_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$大塚$$
「Anyway, we're told we must never let it
　reach the point I'm about to designate!」

stage0018_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$くらら$$
「Doesn't look like anything special is there, but...」

stage0018_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$大塚$$
「If that Angel reaches the point,
　the world might be destroyed!」

stage0018_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$タケル$$
「An Angel... the world's ruin...
　Is that thing what I saw in my nightmare...?」

stage0018_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Save the questions for later.
　Right now, our job is to stop it.」

stage0018_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$葵$$
「Roger that...!
　This is payback for the Federation!」

stage0018_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah!
　Can't just sit still hearing the world's about to end!」

stage0018_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$n
「What's going on!?
　The damage isn't getting through at all!」

stage0018_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That thing stretched across the front...
　Is it a barrier or something!?」

stage0018_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$冬月$$
「So it is an A.T. Field after all.」

stage0018_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yeah...
　Conventional weapons are useless against an Angel.」

stage0018_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$木下$$
「The fact that it has something like that,
　doesn't that make it a true monster!?」

stage0018_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ボス$$
「How the hell are we supposed to fight that!?」

stage0018_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Nothing in this world is invincible or absolute!
　If that thing's got a field,
　we just smash through it with even more power!」

stage0018_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$大塚$$
「$$竜馬$$'s right!
　Hit it with everything you've got!」

stage0018_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「This fight... might be the toughest one yet...」

stage0018_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$冬月$$
「The Fourth Angel...
　It's quite something.」

stage0018_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$冬月$$
「...a report just came in.
　They've apparently arrived.」

stage0018_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then, I leave the rest to you.」

stage0018_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Yes sir, with $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s bombardment then.」

stage0018_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「Taking an attack like that without a scratch...!」

stage0018_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The damage isn't getting through...!
　Is it a barrier or something!?」

stage0018_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$冬月$$
「So it is an A.T. Field after all.」

stage0018_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Yeah...
　Conventional weapons are useless against an Angel.」

stage0018_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$木下$$
「The fact that it has something like that,
　doesn't that make it a true monster!?」

stage0018_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ボス$$
「How the hell are we supposed to fight that!?」

stage0018_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Nothing in this world is invincible or absolute!
　If that thing's got a field,
　we just smash through it with even more power!」

stage0018_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$大塚$$
「$$竜馬$$'s right!
　Hit it with everything you've got!」

stage0018_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「This fight... might be the toughest one yet...」

stage0018_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$冬月$$
「The Fourth Angel...
　It's quite something.」

stage0018_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$冬月$$
「...a report just came in.
　They've apparently arrived.」

stage0018_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then, I leave the rest to you.」

stage0018_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$甲児$$
「A Mechanical Beast corps, at a time like this!」

stage0018_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
???
「For you, who inherit $$ゼウス$$'s power,
　to talk so weak, of all things.」

stage0018_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
Ashura
「That's right.
　Your nemesis and archenemy, $$あしゅら男爵$$.」

stage0018_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「That's the one who was like Dr. Hell's
　right hand, $$あしゅら男爵$$...」

stage0018_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'd heard stories, but
　I didn't know it looked that bizarre...」

stage0018_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$タケル$$
「It's a survivor of the ancient Mycenae Empire.」

stage0018_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$タケル$$
「Originally, I hear, they were a married couple,
　but Hell, trying to use Mycenae's legacy
　Mechanical Beasts, remade them into that form.」

stage0018_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$竜馬$$
「And when it found out Dr. Hell had been deceiving it,
　in the end it teamed up with $$甲児$$ and took Hell down.」

stage0018_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But that doesn't make it an ally, does it...」

stage0018_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The alliance was only temporary.
　It and $$甲児$$, well, call them archenemies.」

stage0018_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$, sure, but
　you're not out for revenge for Dr. Hell, are you...!」

stage0018_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Get out of the way, $$あしゅら$$!
　I don't have time for you right now!」

stage0018_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Ignorance truly is foolish...
　Letting that thing go would have been your happiness.」

stage0018_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Does $$あしゅら男爵$$ know about the Angels!?」

stage0018_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Of course.
　Along with our memories, we've also regained
　Mycenae's knowledge of all the cosmos.」

stage0018_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But I'll strike you all down here, by my own hand!
　That's my own way of settling things!」

stage0018_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you saying you don't care if the world ends!」

stage0018_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「A world like this means nothing to us.
　Whether it's destroyed or not, do as you please.」

stage0018_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But, $$兜甲児$$!
　While I still live, I must settle this
　between us, once and for all!」

stage0018_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't listen to it, $$甲児$$!
　No time to deal with a selfish revenge fiend!」

stage0018_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$さやか$$
「B, but taking on both that monster
　and the Mechanical Beast corps at once...」

stage0018_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$甲児$$
「We've got no choice but to do it anyway!
　We don't plan to die here,
　and we won't let the world end either!」

stage0018_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That's the spirit, $$兜甲児$$!
　Now, before the new century begins,
　let's put an end to our feud!」

stage0018_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, $$あしゅら$$!
　I'll smash your precious Mechanical Beasts
　right along with the Angel, and settle this!」

stage0018_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is bad!
　At this rate, it's going to...!」

stage0018_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Hahahahaha!
　$$兜甲児$$, now the world ends,
　and a new world begins!」

stage0018_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「You too should open the door to god!」

stage0018_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Of course not.
　As long as the Angel lives, we have no future.」

stage0018_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$大塚$$
「Wh, what are you planning to do!?」

stage0018_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I will show you the might of NERV.」

stage0018_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$冬月$$
「Ikari, are you certain about this?」

stage0018_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$タケル$$
「That thing... is that a robot...!?」

stage0018_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（Just as I thought, it's come out...）

stage0018_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（That's the key to the forbidden door...）

stage0018_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Final safety lock, release!
　$$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$, lift off!」

stage0018_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$$シンジ$$, just focus on walking for now.」

stage0018_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$大塚$$
「Ah, Commander Ikari!
　Is that thing really all right!?」

stage0018_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If it's an EVA, closing to melee range
　can neutralize the Angel's A.T. Field.」

stage0018_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But now, we've no choice but to rely on that robot!」

stage0018_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can you hear me, pilot of the purple robot!
　We'll cover you, so hold that thing off!」

stage0018_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even if you say that to me...!」

stage0018_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$マコト$$
「The Angel's attack hit the Umbilical Cable!」

stage0018_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$ can't pull off reconnecting the cable now!」

stage0018_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Listen, $$シンジ$$!
　The EVA can only run three more minutes!」

stage0018_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「In those three minutes, work with the robots
　around you and take down the Angel!」

stage0018_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You're not alone!
　We'll back you up,
　and there are others fighting with you too!」

stage0018_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Run, $$シンジ$$!
　The Angel's after the EVA!」

stage0018_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-01 is at its operational limit!」

stage0018_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Recover Unit-01 while it can still move!」

stage0018_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Run, $$シンジ$$!
　The Angel's after the EVA!」

stage0018_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Sync graph inverted!
　The pulse is flowing backward!」

stage0018_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Cut the circuit!
　Hold it back!」

stage0018_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$マヤ$$
「It's no good!
　Signal rejected, not receiving!」

stage0018_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...This is as far as we go.
　Abort! The rest goes to the Far East Branch!」

stage0018_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Pilot safety is top priority!
　Force-eject the entry plug!」

stage0018_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$マヤ$$
「It's no good!
　It's completely out of control!」

stage0018_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$マヤ$$
「No way! It shouldn't be able to move!」

stage0018_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$マヤ$$
「U, Unit-01 neutralized the Angel's A.T. Field,
　and defeated it...」

stage0018_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So easily, it took out an Angel...」

stage0018_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Everything is the same!
　Yes... everything!」

stage0018_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But what happens after this...!?
　Will it go down the same path again!」

stage0018_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「I'll see that for myself, with these eyes!」

stage0018_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wait, $$あしゅら$$!
　What do you know!?」

stage0018_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「We'll meet again, $$兜甲児$$!
　I'll play along until the time is ripe!」

stage0018_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Can we really call this a win...?」

stage0018_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$甲児$$
「How about it, $$あしゅら$$!
　Your Mechanical Beast army is wiped out!」

stage0018_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「I'll give you that much, $$兜甲児$$.」

stage0018_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But you will regret this, in time.
　That we didn't strike you down here.」

stage0018_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm not interested in your nonsense!」

stage0018_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wait right there, $$あしゅら$$!
　Once we beat the Angel, I'll settle with you!」

stage0018_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$甲児$$
「The Mechanical Beast that Mazinger and I
　first fought is back again!」

stage0018_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how many times you revive,
　$$マジンガーＺ$$ will smash you every time!」

stage0018_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how tough the barrier,
　it's bound to crack eventually!」

stage0018_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go!
　We'll stop the world's ruin ourselves!」

stage0018_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We've fought unknown enemies before,
　plenty of times already!」

stage0018_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　We have to stop it, no matter what!」

stage0018_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, you!
　What are you thinking!?」

stage0018_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Do you even get it!?
　If the world gets destroyed, even you
　standing there would be in trouble too!」

stage0018_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you get it, turn right around and scram!」

stage0018_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$竜馬$$
「There's no such thing as invincible!
　Especially not in front of me!」

stage0018_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we go, poker face!
　Getter and I will punch through your barrier!」

stage0018_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$葵$$
「We're both poker-faced, sure,
　but you've got zero charm about it.」

stage0018_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$葵$$
「I don't know what you're thinking,
　but I... don't hate this world.」

stage0018_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$葵$$
「So, that being the case,
　I'll happily smash that scary angel flat!」

stage0018_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$n
「An Angel... an angel...
　But this one is... different...」

stage0018_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$n
「But I won't let you through!
　I won't let the world be destroyed!」

stage0018_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Calm down, $$シンジ$$...!
　Watch its movements and respond carefully!」

stage0018_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Once you're in the EVA, no more excuses!
　That's the weight you chose to carry!」

stage0018_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You don't need to think about that now!
　Just focus on surviving first!」

stage0018_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$タケル$$
「angel... Angel... destruction...
　Just what is about to happen...」

stage0018_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$タケル$$
「...There's no time for extra thoughts now!
　Focus on beating what's in front of me!」
